name: Mine Protection
author: SCUMSA
description: Punishes players who arm a mine or trap OUTSIDE their (or their squad's) flag area — teleports them onto their own armed mine so it detonates. Reads the manager's canonical world scan (reliable armed + placer detection), squad-aware, escalates from a warning to the penalty, and punishes an offline placer the moment they reconnect. State survives restarts. Configure it all from its admin tab: an illustrated mine/trap picker with live placed/armed counts, escalation rules, exemptions (with an online-player picker) and a live feed of recent actions.
